notes.title: WE DID IT, STEAM!
notes.content:
[h2]HERE WE GO![/h2]
The wait is over! [b]THEMIS is officially OUT NOW[/b] - no more delays, no more wondering if it's good or bad, and no more sleepless nights stressing over whether we left in a game-breaking bug, an unfinished line of dialogue, or—oh no, did we forget something? No, it’s fine… right? Right??

[h2]POST-LAUNCH LOVE 💙[/h2]

This isn’t a goodbye - it’s just the beginning! We’ll be lurking on Steam, YouTube, and every dark corner of the internet ([i]wherever people talk about the game[/i]) to listen, fix, and improve. THEMIS may not be the greatest game ever made, but it’s definitely the greatest game we’ve ever made, and we’re going to treat it like the beloved, slightly janky child it is.

Expect hotfixes, patches, and an unreasonable amount of caffeine-fueled problem-solving in the coming weeks and months.

[h2]TELL US EVERYTHING![/h2]
Who gets to decide if the game is fun, broken, or an absolute masterpiece? You do, Awakened! We’ve done our part - now it’s up to you to tell us:
[*]Did we nail it?
[*]Did we miss the mark by a mile? ([i]Or for our U.S. players, by eight bald eagles per football field?[/i])

Post your impressions, bugs, or bizarre in-game moments in the forums, share your screenshots and videos, and leave an honest Steam review - roast us with sarcasm, and we’ll probably love you for it. Who knows? Your feedback might even shape post-launch patches ([i]or at least prevent us from making the same mistakes next time[/i]).

[h2]THANK YOU! 🙌[/h2]

Huge shout-out to everyone who played the demo, shared feedback, or just supported us along the way. You helped us turn this wild idea into reality, and we hope you enjoy THEMIS at least half as much as we loved making it.

Now, go forth and conquer The Sequence - we’ll see you in there (by spying on the Achievement gain rate in our super secret Steam data page)! 🚀

notes.title: JUDGMENT DAY IS NEIGH
notes.content:
[h3]Hello there, Awakened![/h3]

The cat’s finally out of the bag! ([i]No, Melanius, not you. You stay put.[/i]) The most anticipated puzzle platformer that almost no one knows about is officially dropping its release date like it’s the hottest secret on Steam! 

Mark your calendars and start rehearsing your "I'm calling in sick" speech for your boss next Friday, because [b]THEMIS will be officially launching on March 28th, 2025![/b]

As for the exact release time? Well, that’s a mystery even to us. It all depends on how many buttons we have to press and how fast we can figure out the correct order.

Also a massive thank you to everyone for your support, especially the brave souls who not only dared to play our demo but also shared their precious feedback, making this game even better! ([i]Read: Actually playable.[/i])

In the meantime, feel free to enjoy the enhanced, fully updated, and lovingly polished free DEMO version. And if you do - good news! Your precious save files will carry over to the full release. Just as we promised. And hopefully, we won't regret that promise because, well, anything’s possible with Unreal Engine…

See you all soon in The Sequence, friends!

With love,
[b]Carp Games Studio[/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes (Demo)
notes.content:
[h2]Hello there, Awakened![/h2]

You blink, and suddenly—boom!—a new update is here. We fixed some things, broke a few others (but then fixed those too), and added new ways for you to question reality. Here’s what’s new:


[h2]Subtitle Support[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added AI-generated subtitles for German, Spanish, and Polish. Now even more people can misunderstand what’s going on!
[/list]
[h2]What we broke and then fixed:[/h2]
[list]
[*] TeleQ thought it was a cube but then decided to become a cuboid. We convinced it to behave.
[*] Mouse sensitivity was just a decorative option. Now it actually does something.
[*] Rebinding the "E" key for dialogues? Didn’t work. Now it does. You’re welcome.
[*] Font sizes were feeling artistic and decided to be different everywhere. We put an end to that.
[*] Melanius in Level 3 chose to stay forever. Now he knows when to leave.
[/list]
[h2]What we added because we care about you:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New posters on the walls telling you what to do. Because who reads tutorials?
[*] A new QR code leading to a video about Melanius. Don’t say we didn’t warn you.
[*] Better graphics for Level 1 - Level 3. Now you can admire the view… or at least say, "Yeah, that looks better."
[*] AI-powered translations for German, Spanish, and Polish. Now more people can enjoy the madness!
[/list]

notes.title: DEMO IS OUT
notes.content:
We have whetted your appetite with some screenshots and trailers first. Now let us give you a little appetizer to go with it!

[b]Playable DEMO is now available[/b] for everyone to download and play from the main store page. You will have a chance to meet Melanius in person, learn the basic mechanics, and see what The Sequence has to offer! Just click the big green button and you are good to go!

As promised - the save files are fully compatible with the full game version, so after purchasing [b]THEMIS[/b] later, you can simply continue where you left off. Or start the whole journey from scratch. It's your choice!

[h3]What are you waiting for, Awakened? The world of Metaspace awaits you![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45395743/e4d82110e43cf12b060580ca13dd6cd7f830ff6f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: THEMIS: DEMO
notes.content:
[h3]UPCOMING DEMO RELEASE[/h3]

We are thrilled to announce that within next few days, you will be able to get a little taste of [b]THEMIS[/b] in a form of a playable DEMO!

At Carp Games Studio, we do realise that looking at screenshots and watching the trailer videos is nice, but to get the true scope of what the game is about - you need to play through at least part of the game first.

Therefore, mark your calendars, as this [b]Friday, 31st January 2025 [/b]we will be releasing a fully playable demo version, taking you through the very first steps of the game.

You'll get the taste of most important mechanics, get introduced to the world of Metaspace, the TU:T0R14L sequence , and will be able to fully explore first three levels to your heart's content.

Last but not least - [b]the save files are compatible[/b] - and will be carried between the demo version and the  full game. So if you like the demo and decide to purchase the whole game, you can simply pick up where you left off!

Stay tuned for more info coming soon, hit us up with your questions or let's connect via social media!
